Rangla Punjabi Couple- Gurpreet Singh Aka Guri

Colorful turbans and a mighty big heart, that’s how cool Sardars are. They laugh, eat and love king-size. Here, we show the variety of emotions and scenes in the life of a super Sardar. With various conceptual poses and props this vector character is perfect for food menus, festival greetings and projects related to Sardars and Sikhism. What’s Inside? Indian Punjabi Sardar is driving a tractor. - Indian Punjabi Sardar is playing a dhol. - Indian Punjabi Sardar is riding a bullet bike. - Indian Punjabi Sardar is talking on the telephone. - Indian Sardar are enjoying food and drink. - Indian Sardar bowing head to pray. - Indian Sardar dancing and using traditional musical instrument Sapp. - Indian Sardar holding a glass in hand and smiling. - Indian Sardar is doing the bhangra. - Indian Sardar is eating and driving the truck. - Indian Sardar is holding a paper and reading. - Indian Sardar is holding a plate of sweets in his hands. - Indian Sardar is holding an alcohol bottle. - Indian Sardar is holding beer mugs in his hands. - Indian Sardar is in the swimming pool. - Indian Sardar is laying on the couch and reading a book. - Indian Sardar is playing hockey. - Indian Sardar is praying and with greet hands. - Indian Sardar is running on a trade mill. - Indian Sardar is sitting at the bar and having a drink. - Indian Sardar is smiling. - Indian Sardar is standing outside the car. - Indian Sardar is winking an eye. - Indian Sardar is working on a laptop. - Indian Sardar sitting and holding a stick in hand. - Indian woman is cycling. - Indian woman is dancing. - Indian woman is holding a tiffin in hand and pot on the head. - Indian woman is making butter from churning. - Indian woman is making embroidery on cloth. - Indian woman is making food on fire. - Indian woman is swinging on the swing. - Indian woman is wearing sunglasses and holding a bag. - Indian woman is holding a water pot in her hand.
